content: Yerɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ min di, u n doonɔ. Mɑ Yonɑtɑm mɑɑ ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ wuuɔ.
Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlu dukɑ suuri
Dɑfidi u dɑ Nɔbuɔ Akimɛlɛkin mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo. Ye Akimɛlɛki u nùn wɑ, yerɑ u nùn sennɔ nɑ kɑ bɛrum, u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ ɑ kɑ sĩimɔ wunɛ turo, bɑɑ tɔn turo u ǹ kɑ nun swĩi.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yɑ̃ku kowo wi wisɑ u nɛɛ, sunɔwɑ u mɑn sɔmburu ɡɑru yiire. U mɑɑ nɛɛ, n ku de ɡoo u n yɛ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u mɑn ɡɔrɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ nɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, su yinnɑ yɑm kɑsɑ.
Tɛ̃ dĩɑ nirɑ̀ ɑ mɔ yɛnuɔ. Ǹ n pɛ̃ɛn nɑ, ɑ mɑn wɑsi nɔɔbu kɛ̃ɛmɑ, ǹ kun mɛ, ye ɑ ɡesi mɔ kpuro.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo wi, u Dɑfidi wisɑ u nɛɛ, pɛ̃ɛ ɡɑɑ sɑri mɑ n kun mɔ pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃, ye ɑ̀ n kɑɑ di, kɑɑ ɡinɑ tɔn kurɔ dɛsirɑri.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u yɑ̃ku kowo wi wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ sun kurɔ dendibu yinɑri kɔ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ sun kue sɑ̀ n tɑbu dɔɔ. Kɑɑ rɑ sere ɡere ɡɔrɑ ye bɑ sun koomɑ mini? Yen sɔ̃, nɛn bwɑ̃ɑbɑ dɛɛre kɔ.
Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo wi, u pɛ̃ɛ ye suɑmɑ u Dɑfidi wɛ̃, domi pɛ̃ɛ ɡɑɑ sɑri mi, mɑ n kun mɔ ye bɑ rɑɑ ɡurɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun di, mɑ bɑ swĩɑ kɔsire kuɑ.
N deemɑ yen tɔ̃ɔ te, Sɔɔlun yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobun wiruɡii u nɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ u kɑ sɑ̃ɑrun wororu ɡɑru ko. Durɔ win yĩsirɑ Dɔɛɡu. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Edɔmu.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Akimɛlɛki bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ yɑɑsɑ ǹ kun mɛ tɑkobi mɔ mi? Domi nɑ ǹ sɑnnɔ yɑ̃nu ɡɑnu suɑmɛ yɛnun di yèn sɔ̃ sunɔ u mɑn bɑɑsi n win ɡɔrɑ ye dɑ fuuku.

Yerɑ Akimɛlɛki wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, tɑkobi ɡɑɑ sɑri mɑ n kun mɔ Goliɑtiɡiɑ wi ɑ ɡo Elɑn wɔwɑɔ. Ye wee, bɑ kɑ bekuru bɔkuɑ bɑ yii yɑ̃ku kowon yɑbe tɑrɑkpen biruɔ. À n ye kĩ, ɑ suo. Mɑ Dɑfidi nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn ye wɛ̃ɛmɑ domi ɡɑɑ rɑɑ ru mɑɑ sɑri ye yɑ ye turɑ.
Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ Filisitibɑn mi
Gɑtiɔ
Yen biru Dɑfidi u seewɑ u dukɑ yɑkurɑ Sɔɔlun sɔ̃ mɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Akisin mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Gɑtin sunɔ.
Adɑmɑ Akisin sinɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ Dɑfidi Isirelibɑn sunɔ, wiyɑ mi? Wi bɑ rɑ n tɔmɑmɔ bɑ n mɔ̀,

content.text: Sɔɔlu u rɑ nɔrɔm nɔrɔm ɡo.
Adɑmɑ Dɑfidi u rɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔku wɔkubu (10.000) ɡo.

content: Mɑ ɡɑri yi, yi Dɑfidi sɑ̃wɑnɑ sere u Akisin bɛrum kuɑ.
Yerɑ u tii ɡɔsiɑ wiiro u dweebu mɔ̀ nɡe ɡɑri bɔkɔ, u seewɑ u yorumɔ wuun kɔnnɔn ɡɑmbobɑ sɔɔ. Mɑ u yɑ̃ɑtɑm wĩimɔ mu kokumɔ win toburɔ.
Mɑ Akisi u win bwɑ̃ɑ be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn tii i wɑ mɑ durɔ wini kun bwɑ̃ɑ do. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kɑ mɑn nùn nɑɑwɑ.
I tɑmɑɑ nɑ ǹ wiiro wɑɑrewɑ i kɑ sere mɑn durɔ wini nɑɑwɑ u mɑn win wiirɑ kookoosu sɔ̃ɔsi? Durɔ winin bweserɑ i ko i duusiɑ nɛn dirɔ?
Dɑfidi u kuɑ
wuuru ɡɑrun wiruɡii
